result.reason: The added clause substantively reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It is generally well drafted, but it applies upon termination of any Order Form while requiring return and deletion of all Customer Data. That could affect data supporting continuing Order Forms and goes beyond what is needed. The obligations should be limited to Customer Data associated with the terminated Agreement or Order Form.
